# Procurement Signal

> Independent B2B intelligence for procurement and supply chain professionals. News, data and guides on U.S. tariffs, supplier risk, input-cost inflation and procurement technology, each with what it means for buyers.

Every story cites its sources. Data pages use official U.S. government data (BLS Producer Price Index via FRED; Federal Register; USTR; CBP).

## Data and tools
- [Cost Pressure Monitor](https://procurement-signal.rydzewski-jason.workers.dev/cost-monitor/): monthly price-pressure readings (rising fast, rising, stable, easing) for 12 purchase categories including steel, aluminum, copper, plastic resins, diesel, ocean freight, trucking, semiconductors and packaging.
- [Tariff & Trade Deadline Tracker](https://procurement-signal.rydzewski-jason.workers.dev/trackers/tariff-deadlines/): U.S. tariff effective dates and expirations.
- [Industry Wire](https://procurement-signal.rydzewski-jason.workers.dev/wire/): daily procurement and supply chain headlines with links to original publishers.
